Package paint.shared.constants

Class PaintGeometry

java.lang.Object
paint.shared.constants.PaintGeometry
public final class PaintGeometry extends Object
Defines geometric constants used for spatial calculations and image rendering within the PAINT application.

The PaintGeometry class centralizes constants related to pixel dimensions, grid scaling, and coordinate systems.
